Gastric lipoma: F9: Physical examination: palpable, movable mass in the upper abdomen
F11: Abdominal ultrasound: large echogenic mass in the gastric antrum compatible with an expansive lesion
F12: Conventional endoscopy: large submucosal bulging mass in the posterior gastric wall with three Forrest III–type ulcerated areas
F14: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen: well-defined, homogeneous, oval mass arising from the posterior gastric wall, measuring approximately 10×6×11 cm
F16: Lesion had fat-tissue attenuation with central contrast enhancement and trabecular architecture but did not invade the peripheral layers
